# Ellnow

> Ellnow (ellnow.com) is a free directory of 207 AI tools across 15 categories. Each listing shows what the tool does, whether it is free, freemium or paid, and an editor's score. New tools are added weekly.

Ellnow lists tools people can sign up for and use directly. Each product is listed once; duplicate or copycat listings are not accepted. Scores are editor's scores, not user reviews. Some outbound links are affiliate links; they do not affect listings or scores.

## Main pages

- [Ellnow home and full tool list](https://www.ellnow.com/): all tools, searchable and filterable by category and pricing
- [FAQ](https://www.ellnow.com/#faq): answers to common questions, such as the best AI video, image, writing, coding and voice tools
- [Submit a tool](https://www.ellnow.com/#submit): how AI tool makers can request a listing

## Guides

- [Best AI writing tools in 2026](https://www.ellnow.com/best-ai-writing-tools): Writing tools grouped by use case
- [Best AI video tools for training teams in 2026](https://www.ellnow.com/best-ai-video-tools-for-training-teams): Video tools grouped by use case
